snippet.title: Runtalis - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ] [4K]
snippet.description:
Runtalis is a 1-5 player turn-based tactical RPG. Coordinate your party, socket powerful Runes, and push your Magic Key against enemies with dangerous affixes. Higher risks unlock greater power in this grid-based, tabletop-inspired challenge. Master your skills or lose your Runes.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4258120/Runtalis/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
